verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an AI model and assistant product, since some vendors ship downloadable weights or on-prem deployments. Nothing in the evidence shows Grok offers this. The docs describe only hosted access through the xAI API and grok.com, with prompts and responses stored on xAI's servers and Grok Bot running on a cloud computer. Even custom MCP connectors need Grok's servers to reach the user's machine over the public internet.
